name: v0.6.7
body:
## Changelog

- Fix the terminal capability probe hanging on macOS or stopping when run as a background job (#109, @bevanjkay)

## Install

**Linux / macOS**
```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/Skardyy/mcat/releases/download/v0.6.7/install.sh | sh
```

**PowerShell (Windows)**
```powershell
irm https://github.com/Skardyy/mcat/releases/download/v0.6.7/install.ps1 | iex
```

**Debian / Ubuntu (.deb)**
```bash
# glibc
curl -LO https://github.com/Skardyy/mcat/releases/download/v0.6.7/mcat_0.6.7_amd64.deb
sudo dpkg -i mcat_0.6.7_amd64.deb

# musl
curl -LO https://github.com/Skardyy/mcat/releases/download/v0.6.7/mcat-musl_0.6.7_amd64.deb
sudo dpkg -i mcat-musl_0.6.7_amd64.deb
```

**Fedora / RHEL (.rpm)**
```bash
# glibc
sudo dnf install https://github.com/Skardyy/mcat/releases/download/v0.6.7/mcat-0.6.7-1.x86_64.rpm

# musl
sudo dnf install https://github.com/Skardyy/mcat/releases/download/v0.6.7/mcat-musl-0.6.7-1.x86_64.rpm
```
